answer: The echo register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and crystal seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 38 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 38 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. The bill scales 18 fold, not the vote. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
